description: is_valid_evm_address validates a STRIPPED local copy of its argument (`c = candidate.strip()` at lib/refill_plan.py:245) but returns only a bool -- it never returns the normalized/stripped value. Every caller then uses the ORIGINAL, unstripped `recipient` string for every downstream operation: the validation check itself at franklin_sol_base_refill.py:615 (`if not is_valid_evm_address(recipient):`), the relay quote payload's "recipient" field at line 673, the build_sign_submit call at line 780, and every ledger row's to_addr=recipient at lines 748/802/852/871/887. This is a validate-vs-use mismatch: a --recipient value with leading/trailing whitespace (e.g. `" 0x1F5b17f41524B02a4ee4d99D4158c86C942e43f3\n"`, plausible if the address is ever piped/interpolated from another tool's output rather than typed directly) would PASS is_valid_evm_address (since the internal strip() succeeds) yet be sent to relay.link's API and recorded in the funding ledger with the whitespace still attached, verbatim. The actual on-chain behavior of relay.link's API given a whitespace-padded recipient string is unverified by this codebase (untested, no live check) -- it may silently accept/trim it, or it may reject/misroute it; either way, the validation function's job (proving the exact string that will be used downstream is a well-formed address) is not actually being done, since it checks a value that is discarded immediately after the check.

additionalEvidence.note: Validation call site: checks is_valid_evm_address(recipient) but keeps using the unstripped `recipient` variable everywhere after.
No test constructs a whitespace-padded candidate to confirm the validate-then-use mismatch does not exist -- the gap is untested as well as unfixed.

remediation: Either (a) have is_valid_evm_address reject any candidate whose stripped form differs from the original (no silent normalization), or (b) have callers use the stripped/normalized value everywhere downstream instead of the raw argparse string. Add a regression test with a whitespace-padded valid-looking address asserting the SAME string that passed validation is the one that reaches relay_quote/build_sign_submit/ledger rows.
